original_test_intent: Verify the Version field inside the SMBIOS Type 1 System Information structure matches the approved system hardware/product revision and persists after reboot, without confusing it with BIOS, OS or other SMBIOS versions.
original_method: Archive the entire Type 1 structure, extract Version from the same System Information record and bind it to Product Name/asset/SKU, compare with the platform recipe, run the approved reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected system revision and reboot plan. Section-aware collection, reboot and comparison are automatable.
safety_requirements: Preserve full Type 1/errors and parse Version only within the intended record.
Do not substitute BIOS Version, BMC version, OS version or another structure's Version.
Stop on placeholder, wrong-SKU mapping, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw Type 1/tool/product identity, extract the record-scoped Version and compare before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, infer revision from unrelated firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the system-version meaning, expected revision and SKU/asset mapping.
Resolve product revision discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 1 query is appropriate, but generic grep is not a robust section-aware parser; stderr suppression and insecure SSH assumptions are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive dmidecode --version and full sudo dmidecode -t 1 output using approved transport; parse Version from the System Information record before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, Version scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate Type 1 Version with Product Name, Manufacturer, Serial/UUID and the approved hardware/SKU revision; compare the same record across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved system identity/revision recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds structure scoping and product/SKU revision correlation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected Type 1 revision and identity mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendors may use Version for a hardware generation, SKU revision or placeholder; the project recipe defines correctness.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a customer-specific hardware revision string. It must explicitly identify the Type 1 field semantics and tested SKU.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected Type 1 Version, product/SKU/asset mapping and tool version
Raw pre-reboot Type 1 plus record-scoped extraction

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently target the Type 1 Version field.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The structure/field are clear; expected revision/package/window are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains Type 1 but replaces unscoped filtering with record-aware evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps section-aware parsing and recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates system hardware revision from all other version fields.

review_improvement: Prevents a matching version from another record or firmware layer from satisfying the system-revision case.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core collection, reboot and comparison steps are software-controlled after approval; no human UI action is required, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies.
